tools.description: Read the app self-published state snapshot (the hidden __bt_state node of an instrumented build). Errors with STATE_NOT_PUBLISHED when the build is not instrumented.
tools.name: app_state

tools.description: Read-only capability check of the target device (developer mode, ECP mode, firmware, video mode) with the exact fix text for anything wrong. Does not take the device lease.
tools.name: device_doctor

tools.description: Read the live SceneGraph tree. Without a selector returns a bounded depth-first node list; with a selector returns only the matching nodes. An empty match is a normal result (matches: []). Output is capped; truncated is true when the cap cut nodes.

selector.description: Match nodes in the live SceneGraph tree. All given keys must hold. Prefer id.

tools.name: inspect_tree

tools.description: List the Roku devices brighttest knows (cached) and the one this session targets, with model, firmware and reachability. Devices come only from the brighttest resolution chain (ROKU_HOST, project .env, cache); no serial numbers or passwords are returned.
tools.name: list_devices

tools.description: Move D-pad focus onto the first node matching the selector (the "click X" of a D-pad world). Returns the keys pressed and the final focused node. Fails with the last focused node when the target cannot be reached. Counts against the press cap.

maxPresses.description: Press budget for this move, default 30

selector.description: Match nodes in the live SceneGraph tree. All given keys must hold. Prefer id.

tools.name: navigate_to

tools.description: Add a mock for matching requests: answer them with the given status and JSON or text body instead of the origin. First match wins, newest rule first. The mock lives until the MCP session ends; there is no way to make it permanent. Not yet connected to the app's live traffic (no hub mounted); only sees proxy-path traffic.

method.description: HTTP method, e.g. GET (any when omitted)

body.description: Text body, when json is not given

times.description: Stop matching after this many hits

tools.name: net_mock

tools.description: List the HTTP requests this session's net proxy has seen (newest last): method, url, status, duration, source and whether a mock answered it (mocked). Auth headers, tokens and sensitive query values are redacted. Optional filters: method, url glob, status. Output is capped by limit. Not yet connected to the app's live traffic (no hub mounted); only sees proxy-path traffic.

limit.description: Entries to return (the newest), default 100, at most 500

tools.name: net_requests

tools.description: Press a remote key on the device, one or more times, spaced by the ECP queue gap. Keys are the Roku remote key names (Up, Down, Left, Right, Select, Back, Home, ...) or Lit_<char> for one literal character. The session has a press cap.

count.description: Presses, default 1, at most 20 per call

tools.name: press

tools.description: Run one *.e2e.yaml flow from the project (path relative to the project root, no ".." and no absolute path) and return the per-step results. A failing flow returns isError with the failing step. The session has a flow-run cap and the call has a duration cap.

path.description: Flow file relative to the project root, ending in .e2e.yaml

tools.name: run_flow

tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the sideloaded app as an inline image. Needs the dev password configured out of band (ROKU_PASSWORD or the device cache); it is never a tool parameter. Only works while the dev channel is in front.
tools.name: screenshot
